Not just what.
Where it comes from.
Every result shows its fault chain: likely cause,
mechanism, fault. Each link carries its own evidence and
its own confidence band, so you can see which part is
measured and which part is inferred.
Restricted hip
rotation
Not measurable directly. Pointed to by: lead
hip turned 31° at impact vs ~45° typical.
Hips move
toward the ball
Measured: 7% of body height from address to
impact. Key frames: address + impact.
Early extension
Decided by the rule table: threshold 4% of body
height.
Phone at hand height, 2.4–3.7 m behind you,
down the line. Whole body and club in frame. 120
fps if your phone can.
One swing clip, mp4 or mov, up to 15 seconds.
Straight from your phone browser at the range.
The fault, its cause, a confidence band on every
measurement, one drill and one mobility exercise.
The MVP checks three common faults with a fixed rule table. Each one is
reported as verified, possible, or not found.
Hips move toward the ball from
address to impact.
Your posture angle changes in the
downswing compared with address.
Your hand path in transition runs above
the backswing path.

svg.text: Capped at medium: measured from the hand path

text.tspan: It tells you when
it doesn’t know.
Cannot analyse
Face-on view, feet out of frame, under 30 fps: no
guessed fault. You get each reason and the filming
guide step that fixes it.
No verified fault found
If your swing has none of the three faults, it says
so instead of forcing one onto you.
Unverified — confirm
with a coach
Anything outside the rule table is labelled
unverified and never gets a drill.

svg.text: A confidence band on every measurement. Clips under 120 fps never get “high”.
Answers are based only on this analysis
Why does it feel like I’m staying down when I’m not?

text.tspan: Your chest stays over the ball, so it feels like you stay down. But in your impact
frame your hips are 7% of your body height closer to the ball than at address. The
wall drill makes it checkable: if your trail glute leaves the wall, you have
extended.

svg.text: From: impact key frame · hip measurement 7% · Wall drill
